syllabus: A writ of error to review a judgment of the highest court of .a State, dismissed for want of jurisdiction without opinion.
summary: ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OP THE STATE OP IOWA.
attorneys: Mr. J. T. Mulvaney for plaintiff in error., Mr. Charles W. Lyon for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Writ of error dismissed for want of. jurisdiction. No further opinion will be filed.1

This case had been once before to this court on writ of error and the writ dismissed. See 209 U. S. 258
